findings.message:
Download service methods take `language: string` and cast it to `Locale`

`fetchParams.lang` is typed `Locale`, and `getCubeFileStream` in `publisher-api.ts` already takes `language: Locale` and passes it through without a cast. The three download methods instead take `language: string` and assert `as Locale` at the call site, so any string compiles and then becomes the `lang` query parameter and the `Accept-Language` header. Every caller (`src/consumer/controllers/consumer.ts:365`, `:368`, `src/publisher/controllers/publish.ts:778`) already passes a `Locale`. Change the parameter type to `Locale` and drop the casts. No caller changes are needed.
